selection_policy.first_pass_goal: Evaluate a small representative set of Groq text-generation models for APAC RAG answer generation.
selection_policy.include_policy: Include production text models that cover speed baseline, quality baseline, and reasoning/structured-output candidates.
selection_policy.defer_policy: Defer preview, multimodal, agentic-tool, or less central models unless first-pass results are insufficient.
selection_policy.exclude_policy: Exclude TTS, STT, prompt-guard, safeguard, moderation, embedding, and other non-answer-generation models.

models.rationale: Text model with JSON mode, but 4K context is small for RAG chunk prompts and the model appears less central to APAC English regulatory evaluation.
